name: DeleteEmptyRowsFromDataTableNode
label: Delete Empty Rows From Data Table
description: Deletes rows from a data table where one or more cells are empty.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: DataTable
fields.label: Data Table
fields.description: The data table containing the rows to process.

fields.name: EmptyRowMode
fields.label: Empty Row Mode
fields.description: Specifies how to detect empty rows.

selectOptions.label: All Empty
selectOptions.description: Row is considered empty only if ALL specified cells are empty.

selectOptions.label: Any Empty
selectOptions.description: Row is considered empty if ANY of the specified cells are empty.

selectOptions.label: Based on Specific Columns
selectOptions.description: Check only specific columns for emptiness.

fields.name: ColumnNamesToCheck
fields.label: Column Names To Check
fields.description: List of column names to check for emptiness (required if 'Empty Row Mode' is 'Based on Specific Columns').
